content.title: Where to watch UMBC vs. Howard March Madness First Four game tonight on free streams, TV
content.text: Updated: Mar. 17, 2026, 3:15 p.m.Published: Mar. 17, 2026, 3:15 p.m.CATSONSVILLE, MD - FEBRUARY 26: DJ Armstrong #3 of the UMBC Retrievers takes a foul shot during a college basketball game against the Bryant Bears at the Chesapeake Employers Insurance Arena on February 26, 2026 in Catonsville, Maryland. (Photo by Mitchell Layton/Getty Images)Getty ImagesIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Dustin Hockensmith | dhockensmith@pennlive.comThe 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball Championship gets under way on Tuesday night with a First Four matchup between aspiring No. 16 seeds UMBC and Howard in Dayton, Ohio. The game is scheduled to start at 6:40 p.m. ET with TV coverage on truTV and streaming on-demand.How to watch #16 UMBC vs. #16 Howard on TV and stream without cableWhen: Tuesday, March 17 at 6:40 p.m. ETWhere: UD Arena, Dayton, OhioTV channel: truTVStreaming on: DirecTV (free trial) | SlingTV (low intro rate) | HBO Max ($19.99/mo.)#16 UMBC vs. #16 Howard: The matchupUMBC enters the March Madness fray via an America East Conference tournament championship with a 24-8 season record and a 12-game winning streak. The Terriers are making the third NCAA Tournament appearance in school history and their first since springing a colossal upset as a No. 16 seed over No. 1 Virginia to cap the 2017-’18 season. UMBC is a middle-of-the-pack offense team averaging 76.2 points per game (No. 166 nationally), but does the job with shooting efficiency and a defense allowing just 67.0 points per contest (No. 28). Howard has a similar statistical profile, scoring 77.5 points per game and allowing 67.8 while ranking among the top 20 in the country in both free throw attempts (No. 16) and free throws made (No. 20). The Bison also force the 10th-most turnovers and hold opponents to the nation’s 12th-worst 3-point percentage (29.9%). They enter NCAA Tournament play on a run of eight straight wins that include a 70-63 win over N.C. Central in the MEAC Championship game.#16 UMBC vs. #16 Howard: Know your live streamsDirecTV (free trial): DirecTV offers a 5-day free trial and a total of $30 off over the first three full months for the Choice Package, which includes 125-plus channels and access to ESPN Unlimited, a $29.99 standalone value featuring all ESPN channels and ESPN+.SlingTV (low intro rate): First full month of streaming runs as low as $29.99 with current offer for 50% off Sling’s Orange & Blue Plan.
